connector.name: Namecheap Api MCP
connector.registryDescription: Namecheap API - domains, DNS, contacts, registrar lock, SSL listing, and pricing.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package namecheap-api-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lanternrow account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NAMECHEAP_API_KEY
env.description: Namecheap API key from Profile -> Tools -> API Access

env.name: NAMECHEAP_CLIENT_IP
env.description: Whitelisted public IPv4 of the machine running this server

env.name: NAMECHEAP_USERNAME
env.description: Username a command runs on behalf of. Defaults to NAMECHEAP_API_USER; differs only for reseller sub-users.
